treatment_type.column_description: Text term that describes the kind of treatment administered.

age_at_treatment_start.column_description: Subject Age in Days at Start of Treatment Course Day Count

age_at_treatment_end.column_description: Subject Age in Days at End of Treatment Course Day Count

treatment_id.column_description: A unique sequence of characters used to identify, name, or characterize the kind of treatment administered.

methylation_array_file_id.column_description: A sequence of characters used to uniquely identify, name, or characterize a data file stored as an electronic record.

methylation_platform.column_description: The equipment used to detect the presence and/or location of methyl groups during DNA or protein analysis.

reporter_label.column_description: The text term to describe the labeled methyl group used as a molecular tag.

percent_tumor.column_description: Numeric value that represents the percentage of infiltration by tumor cells in a sample.

percent_necrosis.column_description: Numeric value to represent the percentage of cell death in a malignant tumor sample or specimen.

license.column_description: Official or legal permission to do or own a specified thing.

diagnosis.column_description: The term which identifies normal and abnormal cells and tissues used to define the presence and nature of disease, as categorized by diagnosis_classification_system property.

diagnosis_category.column_description: The term which identifies normal and abnormal cells and tissues used to define the presence and nature of disease, as categorized by diagnosis_classification_system property.

treatment_agent.column_description: The name of the individual therapeutic agent(s) used as part of a treatment regimen.

treatment_response_id.column_description: In medicine, an improvement related to treatment. One or more characters used to identify, name, or characterize the nature, properties, or contents of a thing.

response.column_description: The result of an evaluation to determine whether pathologic and/or clinical changes resulted from treatment.

age_at_response.column_description: The age (in days) of subject when the response assessment was made.

response_category.column_description: A text term based on categorization of the pathologic and/or clinical changes that result from treatment, including eradication of detectable disease, stabilization of disease, or disease progression.

response_system.column_description: The type of standard from which a judgment concerning tumor response to therapy can be established.

crdc_id.column_description: The crdc_id is a unique identifier that is generated by CRDC Data Submission Portal.
